claims.claim: The repository implements bounded active-reflectance inference, abstention, adversarial benchmarks, and a v1 reference/geometry/gain workflow.
The feasible interval contains q when the forward model, deterministic error bound, geometry bound, visibility mask, and clean-reference assumptions hold.
v1 reduces aggregate false-clean from 100% to 25% across the four prioritized fixed-seed synthetic failure constructions.
The implementation detects real cleaning residues with useful sensitivity or specificity.
The implementation proves real-world cleanliness, zero false-clean rate, microbial absence, species/strain identity, sterility, or a real LOD.
The sensing principle or workflow is novel or patentable.

system_maturity_wording: Early research candidate with computational evidence; physical system validation and experimental TRL remain unestablished.
